blocks.text: When currency fails, rocks and oil survive.
Commodities are raw materials. Oil, Gold, Silver, Wheat.
Unlike stocks, they don't produce earnings. A bar of gold will remain one bar of gold forever. It won't give birth to a baby gold bar (Dividend).

Jewelry: You pay 20% Making Charges + 3% GST. Resale value is lower. This is Consumption, not Investment.
Digital Gold / ETF: Pure price exposure. Efficient.
blocks.title: 👑 Investment vs Ornament

blocks.text: The only asset in the world that gives you Gold Price Appreciation + 2.5% Interest.
Issued by RBI. No storage risk. Tax-free if held till maturity (8 years). It is mathematically the best way to own gold in India.

Gold has a Negative Correlation with Equity.
When Stock Market crashes (fear), Gold usually shoots up. Having 10% Gold in your portfolio acts as a shock absorber. It reduces portfolio volatility without killing returns.
